difficulty.label: 极限
difficulty.clearance_definition: additional L-infinity expansion per side of the 4x4 hitbox; sampled ticks, current blue activation

timing_coverage.selection: spatial risk with time separation, then temporal strata
timing_coverage.scope: local_prefix_only; each probe reexecutes source and its own GetHeartPos

flags: 路线存在不超过 3px 的单侧空间余量
抽测中存在提前或延后一 tick 均碰撞的操作
路线存在一秒内至少八次输入事件

limitations: Spatial clearance is instantaneous, not a guarantee under velocity/input errors.
Only selected input events and bounded local timing shifts were tested.
A hard found route does not prove the attack is humanly impossible.
